title: D&D 5.5e SRD Tools
description: Top-level array of tools. Entities rather than free strings so that proficiency grants reference them by id, and so an open pool such as Skilled's 'any skill or tool' can resolve dynamically.

category.description: Artisan's tools, gaming sets, and musical instruments are named as groups by features that grant 'one of your choice'.

ability.description: The ability a check using this tool is normally made against. Omitted where the rules say it varies.

weight.description: Pounds. Omit where the rules say it varies.

variants.description: Forms that each need their own proficiency, as a Gaming Set's dice or a Musical Instrument's lute. Price and weight live on the variant when they differ by form.
